description: This file defines a utility enum 'MicRefreshSupport' that provides functions for managing microphone refresh behavior, scheduling tasks, selecting microphone names, and creating bindings related to voice wake functionality within an audio input context.

methods.name: startObserver
methods.description: Starts an audio input device observer and triggers a refresh callback upon changes.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a refresh task with a delay, canceling previous ones, executing the provided action after the delay.

methods.name: selectedMicName
methods.description: Returns the name of the selected microphone device based on its ID.

methods.name: voiceWakeBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding to the voice wake state within the app's state, updating asynchronously.
